name: Malltale
source:
Set in the nostalgia of the early 2000s, Malltale is a visual novel/dating sim based on the UTMV AU........ Malltale! 

Head to the foodcourt, hang out at Hot Topic, or check out Chapters in search of that recent new best-seller you've been dying to pick up-- on the way you'll run into a host of familiarly-unfamiliar faces who just so happen to be in the mood to make a new friend (or maybe something more...?). 

With seven fresh faces to meet, the Malltale VN is a fun, light-hearted dating sim made by two friends who thought "well, how hard could it be to make one of these?" (answer: pretty hard!).  There's lots to encounter and plenty to explore, with all the silly Malltale energy we've come to adore!

[From [url=https://bluebellpress.itch.io/malltale-vn]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在21世纪初的怀旧氛围中，《Malltale》是一款基于《传说之下》多元宇宙架空设定——Malltale——制作的视觉小说兼恋爱模拟游戏！

去美食广场逛逛，在Hot Topic打发时间，或到Chapters书店寻找那本让你心痒已久的新畅销书。一路上，你会遇见许多既熟悉又陌生的面孔，而他们恰好都想交个新朋友（或是发展更进一步的关系…？）。

七位新面孔等你结识！《Malltale》是一款轻松有趣的恋爱模拟游戏，由两个抱着“做这种游戏能有多难？”念头的朋友制作。（答案：还挺难！）这里有丰富的邂逅与探索内容，也充满了我们喜爱的、属于Malltale的傻气活力！

[摘自[url=https://bluebellpress.itch.io/malltale-vn]Itch.io[/url]]
